Product Details: Dexolac Infant Formula Powder Stage 1 is specially formulated to support the nutritional needs of babies up to 6 months of age. Crafted by Nutricia, this infant formula is enriched with Ironbiotics, a unique blend that combines iron with probiotic fibre to support your baby's overall development. The formula contains 30 vital nutrients carefully selected to help your little one grow and thrive during the crucial early months of life. Dexolac Stage 1 is designed to be gentle on your baby's delicate digestive system, making it a reliable feeding option when required. The powder format makes it convenient to prepare and store. Please note that mother's milk is best for your baby. Always consult your paediatrician before introducing any infant formula. Follow the preparation instructions on the packaging carefully to ensure safe and hygienic feeding for your baby.
